pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: SERVICE-queue-backlog triggered (HIGH) - queue-processor backlog > 150k for 3m. Alert link: https://pd.example/INC12345
incident-bot: Incident created: autoscale-failure / queue backlog. Severity: High. Affected service: inference-queue (prod). Initial metric snapshot: backlog=177k, consumer-lag=98%, p99-token-latency=3.1s.
Maya (oncall): ack. I'm on it.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by Maya (oncall).
Jordan (eng): grabbing grafana -> saml dashboard. Looks like scale-controller failed to provision new workers starting ~12:02 UTC. Events show repeated create-node -> error: "KMS permission denied" when attaching disk to nodes.
Sam L: hmm, did a recent KMS key rotation happen?
Maya (oncall): not aware. Checking infra change logs.
Maya (oncall): @Jordan can you paste the scale-controller logs?
Jordan (eng): logs snippet:
```
I0301 12:01:54 scale-controller.go:412] evaluating desired replicas: target=300, current=60
E0301 12:02:01 provider.go:128] failed to create instance: AttachVolume failed: AccessDenied: user does not have kms:Encrypt on key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd
E0301 12:02:01 scale-controller.go:438] reconcile error: provider create failed; retrying
```
Sam L: That KMS error would stop nodes from joining. If nodes can't attach volumes they never register -> autoscaler keeps retrying but no capacity.
Maya (oncall): customer impact?
Jordan (eng): outbound call counts show 503 spikes for model endpoints behind this queue. Estimated affected requests: ~12k rps partially degraded, 503 rate ~2.3%. Top-tier customers may see higher latency / occasional 5xx.
Maya (oncall): marking as customer-impacting. Paging L2 per runbook.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation to L2 (oncall rotation) in 5m if unresolved.
Aisha (ops): oncall L2 here, joining. If KMS policy is root cause, we can temporarily bypass by switching to fallback provider or using existing warmpool nodes.
Sam L: Warmpool has ~40 idle nodes in us-east-1 but they were never drained to inference cluster (different ASG). We could move traffic or shift queue processing to regional pool if service supports cross-region.
Jordan (eng): short term: two mitigations: 1) manual override on scale-controller to force creation using a different IAM role that has kms:Encrypt for that key; 2) reduce ingress pressure by rerouting a fraction of traffic to fallback model variant and reduce new requests via weight adjustments.
Maya (oncall): I'll start with traffic weight shift to reduce load and buy time; Jordan please attempt a manual provision using role "scale-override-role".
Maya (oncall): Applying traffic weights: `infractl traffic adjust --service inference-api --route default --weight 0.6 --region prod` (reducing to 60%).
Maya (oncall): done. Observing ingress drop ~40% within 30s.
Jordan (eng): attempting provision override:
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it deploy/scale-controller -- /bin/sh -c "./scalectl create-node --role scale-override-role --count 120"
```
Jordan (eng): create attempts show attach succeeded for first 6 nodes, then another KMS error for a subset: looks like role has kms:Encrypt but not on that key alias pattern. Some accounts allowed, some not.
Sam L: we can also flip to warmpool by attaching the ASG instances to the cluster: `asgctl attach --asg warmpool-inference --cluster inference-prod` — that should register nodes without creating new ones.
Aisha (ops): doing asg attach now.
Aisha (ops): asg attach returned success, nodes joining... kube nodes: +28 within 2m.
Maya (oncall): backlog dropping from 177k -> 86k. p99 latency -> 1.8s. Good.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Reminder - escalation to L2 canceled (acknowledged by Aisha).
Jordan (eng): followup: I opened a ticket with infra-security to check the KMS key policy and cross-account role permissions. Root cause likely a recent KMS key rekey that restricted Encrypt to a subset of IAM roles.
Sam L: for immediate relief I'm going to adjust scale-controller to skip volume encryption for ephemeral worker volumes (config flag) so nodes can attach. This reduces security posture slightly but gets us online faster. Approval?
Maya (oncall): Dangerous but ok for emergency only. Approving for 30m window. Change command: `kubectl -n infra patch deploy/scale-controller --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"scale-controller","env":[{"name":"SKIP_VOLUME_ENCRYPTION","value":"true"}]}]}}}}'`
Sam L: patch applied. New node creates no longer hit KMS attach errors.
Maya (oncall): monitoring backlog: 86k -> 40k -> 12k over next ~8m. p99 latency down to 800ms.
Aisha (ops): Logged customer impact: some customers had transient 5xx and higher latencies; support ticket count increased by 9 during the window.
Jordan (eng): opening post-incident task list: 1) revert SKIP_VOLUME_ENCRYPTION and fix KMS policy; 2) add health-check to scale-controller to detect KMS attach failures sooner and switch to warmpool automatically; 3) add runbook step to attach warmpool ASG for this service; 4) audit KMS key rotations and add CI guardrail.
Maya (oncall): I'm going to hand off to Aisha for monitoring and cleanups. Current state: backlog=11.6k, consumer-lag=12%, p99=0.82s, node count=220, autoscaler now stabilizing but we left manual override and SKIP_VOLUME_ENCRYPTION set.
Maya (oncall): Aisha, take it from here. I'll join for 10m then drop off.
Aisha (ops): Taking handoff. Summary -> cause: KMS key permission regression after rotation prevented new nodes from attaching encrypted volumes => autoscaler retries but cannot provision => queue backlog grew. Immediate mitigation -> traffic weight reduction, attach warmpool ASG, temporary skip of volume encryption. Impact -> transient 5xx for customers, ~2.3% overall 503 rate at peak, support spike 9 tickets. Followups assigned.
Aisha (ops): Will monitor for 30m and start followups with infra-security.
Maya (oncall): Thanks team. Closing PD incident notes and adding timeline to incident doc.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by Aisha (ops). Status: monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 updated: mitigation in place, monitoring. Next update due in 30m or on any regressions.
Aisha (ops): leaving a short checklist for whoever owns the fix: [ ] revert SKIP_VOLUME_ENCRYPTION, [ ] update KMS key policy, [ ] add warmpool attach runbook, [ ] postmortem + customer communication draft.
Maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: noted. Handed off at 12:43 UTC.
Aisha (ops): On it.
